description.value: On the Rocks is an indoor climbing and bouldering gym in Campbell River staffed by certified rock climbing guides, offering three distinct climbing areas and a full program roster spanning beginner intro sessions through advanced outdoor multi-pitch and rock rescue courses. The gym fosters a strong local community through regular events like crag clean-ups and competitions, and also serves as a gateway to nearby outdoor climbing at Crest Creek Crags. A touring cyclist looking for an active day off the bike or wanting to connect with local outdoor adventure culture would find this a compelling stop.
